regulatory_descriptor: A Non linked, Non Participating, Individual, Life Insurance Savings Plan
key_benefits: Guaranteed Sum Assured on Maturity (110% x PPT x Annualized Premium) plus Guaranteed Additions paid at maturity, if all premiums paid
Guaranteed Additions as a multiple of one Annualized Premium (not payable on lapsed/paid-up policy)
Death Benefit = higher of (Sum Assured Multiple x Annual Premium) or Sum Assured, subject to Guaranteed Death Benefit of 105% of Total Premiums Paid
'Low Cover Mark-up' (extra Guaranteed Additions) if a sum-assured multiple of 7x or 5x Annual Premium is chosen
Limited premium payment term; non-medical savings plan
Option to take policy loan and to alter premium payment mode
Settlement Option to receive maturity benefit in instalments (5–15 years)

eligibility.premium_payment_term: Limited premium payment (options not recovered from parse)
eligibility.note: Numeric eligibility table (entry/maturity ages, sum-assured multiples beyond 5x/7x note, PT/PPT options) not recovered from this brochure parse. A 90-day waiting period applies for non-accidental death. Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Policy Document; refund of premium less proportionate risk premium and medical/stamp-duty expenses; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death by suicide within 12 months from commencement of risk or latest revival (whichever is later), nominee receives higher of 80% of Total Premiums Paid or surrender benefit as on date of death, provided the policy is in force.
key_terms.waiting_period: First 90 days from commencement of risk; on non-accidental death during the waiting period only 100% of premiums paid (excluding extra premium/taxes) is payable. Not applicable on revival.
key_terms.loan_note: Loan up to 80% of surrender benefit; current interest 9% p.a. compounded half-yearly, benchmarked to 10-year G-Sec + 2%.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws as amended from time to time'; consult a tax consultant. GST per prevailing tax laws.

claims_marketing_must_support: 'Guaranteed' is supportable here — the plan provides a Guaranteed Sum Assured on Maturity and Guaranteed Additions; but Guaranteed Additions are payable ONLY if all due premiums are paid (not on a lapsed/paid-up policy) and must be so qualified.
Any 'Low Cover Mark-up' / enhanced-addition claim is condition-bound on choosing a 7x or 5x Annual Premium sum-assured multiple.

Death benefit floor is 105% of Total Premiums Paid; during the first 90-day waiting period only 100% of premiums is paid for non-accidental death — any death-cover claim must reflect the waiting period.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT use 'bonus' language — this is a non-participating plan; there are no bonuses, only Guaranteed Additions.
Do NOT position as a market-linked or investment product — it is non-linked.
Do NOT omit the 90-day waiting period when describing death cover.
Do NOT imply Guaranteed Additions accrue on a lapsed/paid-up policy.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'subject to prevailing tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non linked, Non Participating, Individual, Life Insurance Savings Plan'
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms and exclusions
